release.label: R1 · Paper evidence gate
release.summary: M0 passed. M1 source is complete; current-tree browser verification remains open.

attention.title: Acknowledge the official hackathon rules
attention.detail: The authenticated account is registered, but the local submission workflow cannot prepare the official draft until the current rules are explicitly acknowledged.

agents.name: Master Agent // Pipeline Control
agents.focus: Unblocking browser evidence, integrating checkpoints, and keeping the deadline critical path moving.

agents.name: Sub Agent 4 // M2 Code
agents.focus: Implementing the Video Origin in fast mode without embedding the final media binary.

agents.name: Sub Agent 5 // CI Gate
agents.focus: Turning tests, builds, registries, and contradiction checks into an automatic GitHub quality gate.

watch.title: Functional proof passed; interaction evidence blocked
watch.detail: Exact result, search navigation, protocol lifecycle, origins, and logs pass. The browser surface is swallowing keyboard focus, so no false PASS will be recorded.

watch.title: Final media slot is defined
watch.detail: The MP4 and captions plug in last. The product evidence video and the under-three-minute Devpost demo remain separate assets.

watch.title: Verify deployed-client parity
watch.detail: Public origins, unsupported/error behavior, and the final browser matrix remain deployment work.

watch.title: Connect Vercel to GitHub
watch.detail: Direct board deployments work now. Push-triggered deployments need the Vercel account's GitHub login connection.

done.title: Protocol foundation
done.detail: Contracts, lifecycle, native probe, topology, and exit record are complete.

done.title: Paper evidence experience
done.detail: Paper search, guided suggestions, semantics, and passage navigation are implemented.

done.title: Video architecture and experience
done.detail: Bounded plan, contracts, exclusions, and evidence requirements are documented.

done.title: Remote attention board
done.detail: Human decisions stay magnified, active agents remain glanceable, and completed work moves into the drawer.

done.title: Late-bound media validator
done.detail: Reserved media and caption paths, duration, timestamp, provenance, license, and checksum rules are machine validated.

done.title: Current-tree functional proof
done.detail: Native result, search navigation, lifecycle, origins, logs, 76 tests, type-check, build, and registry validation pass. Keyboard and narrow capture remain blocked.

done.title: Deadline and asset registry
done.detail: Machine-readable ownership, dependencies, proof paths, user gates, asset status, and contradiction checks are in place.

milestones.title: 1 of 7 passed
milestones.detail: M1 cannot exit on the current tree until fresh browser evidence is captured.

milestones.title: M2 → M3 → M4
milestones.detail: Video Origin, Shared Actions, then Semantic Stage remain deliberately sequential.

evidence.title: M1 Chrome registry v2
evidence.detail: Five pass, zero fail, two truthful environment-blocked observations for the recorded historical source.

evidence.title: Paper tests and build
evidence.detail: Focused Paper tests, TypeScript, production build, and both manual registry validators pass.
